sources.section: 💾 GPU Rental Services for Large Language Models
sources.entry: 6. Vast.ai - A marketplace for renting affordable AI compute, including GPUs.

summary.name: Vast.ai
summary.one_liner: Vast.ai is a GPU rental marketplace where prices are set by supply and demand, offering on-demand cloud GPU instances, serverless model endpoints, and multi-node clusters for AI workloads.
use_cases: Renting GPUs for training or fine-tuning machine learning models
Running LLM or vision-language model inference
Large-scale multi-node training on InfiniBand clusters
Programmatically provisioning GPUs via API for AI agents
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Vast.ai as a GPU infrastructure layer with API-native provisioning, real-time pricing across 20,000+ GPUs, and per-second billing. Users can search GPUs by model, VRAM, price and availability through the console or API, then launch instances. It offers three deployment types: GPU Cloud on-demand instances across 40+ data centers, Serverless endpoints with autoscaling to zero, and dedicated multi-node Clusters with InfiniBand networking. It also lists launchable pre-configured templates for popular open-source models such as Qwen, MiniMax and Kimi K3.
notable: Marketplace pricing set by real-time supply and demand across 20,000+ GPUs
API-native provisioning and per-second billing, designed for programmatic use
Serverless endpoints with automatic benchmarking and autoscale to zero
Pre-configured templates for popular open-source models
caveats: Requires adding credit (minimum stated as $5) before use
Page does not state full pricing details; actual rates vary with market supply and demand
